book.name: Mbouŋ To Yes Israela
book.title: Mbouŋ To Yes Israela Buk Song—Psalms

content.text: Aleluia, tapait Yoova!
Yau naghe napakur Yoova toman lolog!
Saawe isov tau naleep izi taan, yau aat napait Yoova.
Pale namboumbou pa Maaron tsiau, ve napapakuru tauvene ila ila le irau saawe tsiau isov.
Anumeer yes daaba ve pooza sov. Yes tamtamon to taan mon.
Irau tigham mulin gham pa pataŋani tsiam mako.
Saawe tau avuvuzi isov ve timaat, yes aat timuul tizila taan.
Mako ŋgar tau muuŋ matazi iŋgali tighe tighamu na, imin kaut sorok. Irau ighur anooŋa mako.
Eemon tamtamon tau ighe inumeer Maaron to Yakop, ve ighamgham uleeŋ ila tooni, i aat loolo poia.
Pasaa, yes tau tinumeer Maaron toozi Yoova ve tighurghur matazi pani pa uleeŋ, ene aat poia to Maaron izazaa toozi.
Yoova ighur sambam, taan, ve te, tomania gabua naol isov tau tileep ve tigheen ila na.
Ve saveeŋ mbuaaŋ tooni isov, i pale maata iŋgali ve itaghoni irau saawe.
Yes tau koiazŋa titatan zi na, Yoova iyozyooz pazi ve iuluul zi pa pataŋani toozi.
Ve yes tau pitool igham zi na, i ighamgham lezi aniiŋ.
Ve yes tau tileep ila koiazŋa nimazi na, i ighamgham mulin zi.
Yes tau matazi kumkuuma na, i igham zi tighita nugh.
Ve yes tau pataŋani itatan zi na, i iuul zi, ve iit zi tizaa.
Yoova loolo ighengheen to zeran duduŋazi.
I maata pa yes to nugh ite,
ve iŋginŋgin yes parooŋa ve zinaara pa lepoogh toozi.
Eemon iponpoon eez pa zeran sasaghati.
Yoova pale igham pooz irau saawe.
Yam tamtamon to nugh Zion, pooz to Maaron tsiam pale ighengheen tauvene iseeŋga iseeŋga gha ila.
Aleluia, tapait Yoova!
